title: Notes window honours [vault].tui as an execution off-switch, the vault gate, and refuses to launch degraded
scope: config/tmux-autostart.sh driven through its documented AGENTBOX_TMUX_AUTOSTART_DRY_RUN=notes hook with a recording tmux stub and fixture rune binaries; no tmux server, no real Rune, no session created

decision.vault_tui: EXECUTION off-switch (runtime, restart-class). tui=none/empty/unset blocks the launch even with a binary present, including the ~/workspace/.cargo/bin fallback.
decision.package_selection: SEPARATE gate, evaluated in flake.nix at BUILD time (rebuild-class): the image bakes rune only when [vault].tui = "rune".
decision.operator_exposure: each refusal message names the gate that refused and the manifest key, and states the build/runtime distinction.

changed: config/tmux-autostart.sh (window-9 decision hoisted into _notes_window(), three gates, dry-run hook)

test.stdout:
